details:
The pcre2 package contains a new generation of the Perl Compatible Regular Expression libraries for implementing regular expression pattern matching using the same syntax and semantics as Perl. 

Security Fix(es):

* pcre2: PCRE2: Out-of-bounds write allows arbitrary code execution via crafted regular expressions (CVE-2026-86145)

* PCRE2: PCRE2: Out-of-bounds read via invalid UTF data during JIT fallback (CVE-2026-89156)

* pcre2: PCRE2: Out-of-bounds write via large pattern input (CVE-2026-89157)

* pcre2: PCRE2: Denial of Service via out-of-bounds read during invalid UTF matching (CVE-2026-89160)

* PCRE2: PCRE2: Out-of-bounds write via integer overflow on 32-bit platforms (CVE-2026-89158)

* pcre2: PCRE2: Memory corruption vulnerability in pcre2_jit_match (CVE-2026-89161)

* pcre2: pcre2: Out-of-bounds write via crafted regular expression (CVE-2026-103111)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
